name: AR5
source_name: IPCC Fifth Assessment Report, WG1 Chapter 8 (Table 8.7 and Table 8.A.1), 100-year GWP without climate-carbon feedback
notes: Read from the published tables on 2026-09-25. This is the basis the DESNZ 2025 conversion factors were built on: its methodology paper states GWP for CH4 = 28 and GWP for N2O = 265. Fossil methane is higher by 2 over 100 years (Table 8.7 footnote b), giving 30. Values without the climate-carbon feedback, which is the convention used for corporate inventories. Refrigerant species read from Table 8.A.1 on 2026-09-25. HFC-134a in Table 8.7 is 1,300 without the climate-carbon feedback, which is the value used.
